response.query: What sample-size and power guidelines are recommended for CFA/IRT and multi-group invariance tests in multi-site African social cohesion measurement (per site and pooled)?
response.answer: For CFA/IRT and multi-group invariance tests in African social cohesion measurement, a minimum sample size of 200 per site and 1,500 pooled is recommended for reliable results. Guidelines suggest at least 10 samples for robust analysis.
